comment: e2m 105A +0 Throttle_100_Fueling [FSMXTHFL] 'Fueling value at 100% throttle.' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (MM3S, 0.0679 mm3 per count; 2390 = 162.4 mm3 here; the 105A block starts at the odd address 0x40a897): the maximum fuel curve at the current engine speed. cm848_calculateFuelDemandWithTrim stores cm848_calculateMaximumFuelCurve(engine speed, 400) + fuel_demand_offset_correction here each pass while the algorithm flag programmable_power_enable is 0, floored at timing_limit_upper.
